story.title: A Lifelong Love for Dogs
story.paragraph1: Hi! I'm Yakir Lavi, and my passion for dog training began over a decade ago. What started as an interest in basic obedience quickly evolved into a deep commitment to classical training methods and the competitive world of IGP (Internationale Gebrauchshunde Prüfung) dog sport.
story.paragraph2: For the past 8 years, I've dedicated myself to mastering IGP training - a demanding sport that tests a dog's tracking abilities, obedience precision, and protection work. This journey has taken me to the highest levels of competition, including the IGP World Championship in 2023.
story.paragraph3: My competitive achievements include 2nd place at the Israel National Championship in 2023, followed by 4th place in 2024 and 5th place in 2025. These competitions aren't just about winning - they're about demonstrating the incredible results that come from structured, classical training methods.
story.paragraph4: Over 10 years of experience, I've trained more than 500 dogs - from family companions needing reliable obedience to working dogs preparing for competitions. I believe in clear communication, consistent structure, and helping every dog reach its full potential through proven training techniques.
story.quote: My mission is to unlock every dog's potential through classical training methods. Whether you want a reliable family companion or a competitive sport dog, I provide the structure, discipline, and expertise to achieve real results.

puppy.title: 🐶 Working Dog Foundation Program
puppy.description: Your puppy is at the ideal age to start structured training! Our Working Dog Foundation Program establishes obedience, builds drive, and creates a solid foundation for future training or sport work.

tips.1: Start with clear boundaries and consistent rules from day one
tips.2: Build drive through play and structured exercises
tips.3: Establish handler focus and clear communication early
tips.4: Assess temperament and aptitude for future sport or work

behavior.title: 🔧 Behavior Modification Program
behavior.description: Using classical training methods, we'll establish clear boundaries and structure to address behavioral challenges. Every behavior problem has a solution through proper leadership and consistent rules.

tips.1: Establish clear rules and boundaries immediately
tips.2: Consistency from all family members is critical
tips.3: Structure and routine help dogs feel secure
tips.4: Leadership and clear communication solve most behavior issues

highEnergy.title: ⚡ IGP Sport Training Program
highEnergy.description: Your energetic dog is an ideal candidate for IGP sport! Channel that drive into tracking, obedience, and protection work. This demanding sport provides the mental and physical challenge high-energy dogs need.

tips.1: High-drive dogs excel in structured sport training
tips.2: IGP provides physical and mental challenges
tips.3: Proper outlet for drive prevents behavior problems
tips.4: Consider joining a local IGP club for training

advanced.title: 🏆 IGP Sport Training
advanced.description: Ready for serious training! IGP sport training develops precision obedience, tracking skills, and protection work. Learn from a trainer with proven success at national and international competitions.

tips.1: IGP training builds incredible dog-handler teamwork
tips.2: Requires commitment but delivers amazing results
tips.3: Competition experience helps develop skills faster
